chat.settings.help.always_show_sidebar_o: Always keep the sidebar visible on desktop devices, rather than having it automatically hide.
chat.settings.help.api_key: If you are using the `--api-key` option to configure the server, please set the API key.
chat.settings.help.ask_for_title_confirm: Before automatically changing the conversation title while editing the initial message, seek confirmation from the user.
chat.settings.help.auto_show_sidebar_on_: When you start a new chat, the sidebar will automatically appear. To keep the sidebar hidden until you click on it, you can disable this feature.
chat.settings.help.backend_sampling: Enable server-side sampling. When enabled, compatible sampling methods will run on the accelerator for improved performance.
chat.settings.help.copy_text_attachments: When copying a message that includes text attachments, combine all the content into a single, unformatted text string rather than copying it in a special format that would require re-attaching the files
chat.settings.help.custom_json: Custom JSON parameters to send to the API. These must be in a valid JSON format.
chat.settings.help.disable_auto_scroll: Disable automatic scrolling as new messages arrive, allowing you to manually control the visible area of the chat.
chat.settings.help.disable_reasoning_par: Send reasoning_format=none to prevent server-side extraction of reasoning tokens into separate field.
chat.settings.help.dry_allowed_length: DRY sampling minimizes redundancy in generated text, even when dealing with extensive input. This parameter defines the permissible length for DRY sampling.
chat.settings.help.dry_base: Using DRY sampling minimizes repetition in generated text, even when dealing with lengthy and complex content. This setting determines the initial value used for DRY sampling.
chat.settings.help.dry_multiplier: Using DRY sampling minimizes repetition in generated text, even when dealing with lengthy and complex prompts. This setting controls the strength of the DRY sampling effect.
chat.settings.help.dry_penalty_last_n: DRY sampling minimizes redundancy in generated text, even when dealing with lengthy input. This parameter defines the penalty applied to the last ‘n’ tokens to achieve this.
chat.settings.help.dynamic_temperature_e: Add-on for the temperature sampling method. It refines the probability distribution by prioritizing the most likely token.
chat.settings.help.dynamic_temperature_r: Add-on for the temperature sampling method. This enhances the range of dynamic temperature values by adjusting probabilities based on the entropy of the tokens.
chat.settings.help.enable_continue_gener: Enable the “Continue” button for messages from the assistant. Currently, this feature only functions with models that do not utilise reasoning capabilities.
chat.settings.help.endpoint: Choose Open-ended Responses (recommended) or Chat-based Responses (older version)
chat.settings.help.frequency_penalty: The number of tokens is restricted, taking into account how frequently they occur in the generated text.
chat.settings.help.keep_stats_visible: Keep the processing statistics displayed even after the generation is complete.
chat.settings.help.max_tokens: The maximum number of tokens in the output. Use -1 to indicate an unlimited (no limit) number.
chat.settings.help.min_p: It restricts the number of tokens based on a minimum probability threshold; a token must have a probability at least as high as this threshold, relative to the probability of the most likely token, to be considered.
chat.settings.help.parse_pdf_as_image: Process PDFs by interpreting them as images rather than text. The system will automatically revert to standard text-based processing for models that do not utilise image processing.
chat.settings.help.paste_long_text_to_fi: When a large amount of text is pasted, it will be saved as a file. You can adjust the maximum file size by changing the value of this setting. Setting the value to 0 will disable this feature.
chat.settings.help.presence_penalty: The number of tokens is restricted, depending on whether they are present in the generated text or not.
chat.settings.help.py_interpreter_enable: Enable the Python interpreter using Pyodide. This allows you to run Python code within markdown code blocks.
chat.settings.help.render_user_content_a: Display user messages in the chat using markdown formatting.
chat.settings.help.repeat_last_n: The number of recent tokens to take into account when discouraging repetition
chat.settings.help.repeat_penalty: Manages the repetition of sequences of words or phrases within the generated text
chat.settings.help.samplers: The order in which sampling methods are applied, in a simplified manner, is as follows: the default sequence is “top_k, then typ_p, followed by top_p, then min_p, and finally temperature”. This can be represented as: top_k → typ_p → top_p → min_p → temperature
chat.settings.help.show_message_stats: Show the generation statistics – including tokens per second, total token count, and duration – beneath each message from the assistant.
chat.settings.help.show_microphone_on_em: For models that support audio input, automatically display the microphone button instead of the send button when the text input field is empty.
chat.settings.help.show_raw_llm_output: Display the unprocessed output from the large language model, without any backend parsing or frontend Markdown formatting, to facilitate inspection of the streaming functionality across various models.
chat.settings.help.show_raw_output_switc: Show a per-message toggle to display plain raw model output instead of Markdown rendering.
chat.settings.help.show_system_message: Show the system message at the beginning of each conversation.
chat.settings.help.show_thought_in_progr: By default, elaborate on your reasoning when creating responses.
chat.settings.help.show_tool_calls: Display the labels and data associated with tool calls from Harmony-compatible delta.tool_calls, presenting this information below the assistant’s responses.
chat.settings.help.system_message: The initial prompt that sets the parameters for the model’s behaviour.
chat.settings.help.temperature: It governs how unpredictable the generated text is by influencing the likelihood of different words or phrases appearing in the output. A higher value leads to more varied and surprising results, while a lower value produces more predictable and consistent text.
chat.settings.help.theme: Select the colour scheme for the interface. You can choose between System (which adapts to your device’s settings), Light, or Dark.
chat.settings.help.top_k: Retains only the top *k* most frequent tokens.
chat.settings.help.top_p: Restrict the selection of tokens to those whose combined probability reaches or exceeds a value of ‘p’
chat.settings.help.typical_p: Categorises and restricts tokens based on the disparity between log-probability and entropy.
chat.settings.help.xtc_probability: The XTC sampler selectively removes frequently occurring words; this setting determines the probability of any word being removed. Setting this to 0 disables the XTC function.
chat.settings.help.xtc_threshold: The XTC sampler removes frequently occurring words; this parameter determines the probability threshold for a word to be removed.
